plan.summary: This 4-week block is the opening building phase of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan with 2 short S&C sessions per week. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the two primary lifts so future percentage work is anchored to your current level, and the main program starts in Week 2. The focus for this block is simple, repeatable strength and power work that fits a beginner boxer, keeps fatigue controlled, and leaves room for skill training.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baselines, build basic strength, and keep power work crisp without creating extra fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and medicine-ball power while keeping the weekly workload recoverable around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Turn the earlier strength gains into faster, sharper outputs with lower fatigue and higher movement speed.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can with a quick dip and a quiet landing. Stop if height drops off.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height that lets you land softly and in control.

exercises.name: 2. Front Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then build to one hard but technically solid top set. Stay braced and stop before form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max for future percentage work.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if the front rack is uncomfortable or unstable.

exercises.name: 3. Chest-Supported Row
exercises.notes: Pull to the lower ribs and pause briefly at the top. Use a load you can control cleanly.

substitutionOptions.name: Seated Cable Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Keep the torso still and finish with the elbows close to the body.

exercises.name: 4. Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Move only as far as you can while keeping the ribs down and lower back quiet.

substitutionOptions.name: Barbell Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use small range at first and keep the body in one line.

exercises.name: 1a. Medicine Ball Chest Pass
exercises.notes: Use a moderate-bounce ball. Throw fast from the chest and reset between reps so each one is explosive.

substitutionOptions.name: Medicine Ball Scoop Toss
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a non-bouncing ball and drive hard from the legs and hips.

exercises.name: 2. Bench Press
exercises.notes: Warm up steadily, then build to one hard and clean top set. Keep the shoulders packed and the bar path controlled.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max for future percentage work.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Bench Press

exercises.name: 3. Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Use a controlled pull and stop with 1-2 reps in reserve. Pull the bar toward the upper chest without leaning back hard.

substitutionOptions.notes: Use enough assistance to keep every rep clean and controlled.
